privacy.title: Privacy Notice (KVKK)
privacy.intro: This notice explains how your personal data is processed under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

privacy.purpose: To create and manage your account, to provide export-readiness services using your company and product details, and to keep the service secure.
privacy.basis: KVKK Article 5: performance of a contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest and, where needed, your explicit consent.
privacy.rights: You may learn whether your data is processed, request information, ask for correction or deletion, object to processing, and claim compensation for damage.
privacy.contact: Send your requests to [Platform operator contact email].
privacy.placeholderNote: Fields in square brackets must be completed by the platform operator before launch.

compliance.title: Compliance Guard
compliance.intro: Find your product's customs code, then see the target market's rules and Turkish state incentives. Every item links to an official source.

compliance.structuralHelp: For example, tick this if screws, bolts or fasteners will be used in construction or load-bearing structures; extra rules may apply.
compliance.processing: Is your product roasted or raw?
compliance.gtipHelp: These are suggestions, not final answers. Choose the best match and confirm it.
compliance.gtipWarning: Confirm the exact 12-digit code with your customs broker.
compliance.tickFailed: Could not save the change; the tick was undone. Please try again.
compliance.formula: Weighted 3 for mandatory, 2 for conditional, 1 for recommended; the weighted percentage of applicable items you have ticked.
compliance.langNote: AI texts are in the language the report was created in. Run the check again to see them in the selected language.
compliance.noMatchTitle: We do not yet have verified information for this product and country
compliance.noMatchBody: We do not make rules up. We recommend asking these bodies:

flags.payment_change: The reply says payment details (account/IBAN) changed. This is a very common export scam; verify by phone.
flags.urgency: There is heavy pressure to hurry. Scammers try to leave you no time to think.
flags.domain_mismatch: An email domain in the reply differs from the lead's saved email domain. This could be impersonation.
flags.upfront_payment: Full or upfront payment is requested. This is common in scams; prefer a letter of credit or partial payment.

incoterms.EXW: Buyer collects at the factory and pays all transport.
incoterms.FCA: Seller hands over to the buyer's carrier, export-cleared.
incoterms.FOB: Seller delivers onto the ship at the Turkish port.
incoterms.CIF: Seller pays sea freight and insurance to the destination port.
incoterms.DAP: Seller delivers to the buyer's address; buyer pays import duties.
